notes: Corrected car-course route uses the direct eastern return beside the covered paddock, excluding the old karting diagonal/upper-arc detour. Exact current OSM source nodes and joins are retained. The operator plan and pinned imagery support branch identity only; no diagram or imagery coordinates are copied. Independent source distance 1238.1 m is not fitted to an operator or catalogue scalar. Historical configuration and driving direction remain draft.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.
Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 66 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Estimated road limits from independent native-image readings and exact reuse of observed controls on shared source sections. Reused coordinates are unchanged observations, not new independent readings; the central image is byte-identical to its subimage in this pinned mosaic. Source-normal anchors retain mapped curvature except the selected local straight intervals. At the northern inner grass corner, visible controls 237 and 258 are 13.45 m apart while the coarse source travels 62.95 m: edge-length-v1 joins those observed endpoints with a straight estimated edge, bounded by 50 m physical edge length, 100 m source span and forward source progression. This approximates a rounded corner with roughly 1 m image-reading uncertainty. No unobserved junction counterpart is labelled measured. Outer stations 379..410 beside the covered paddock are roof-obscured and interpolated over roughly 93 m; pedestrian access and shared-paving openings also remain estimated. Original source trace/timing retained; no complete-source containment claim. Configuration/direction draft, coarse terrain approximate, curbs illustrative, banking unknown. No nominal width or inferred seed observation.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
